W.note: Fast press, a shallow kick-and-catch release, and a slow-grip settle give three clearly different moves, shown with labeled graphs, a playhead, phase and progress readouts, a reference curve, a pause toggle, and JS reduced-motion handling.

X.note: The Sticky Anticipation undershoot-then-snap is the most grip-like motion in the set, but the Punch Overshoot peak is clipped by the SVG viewBox, dots clip at the pill edges, values are only in the spec line, and reduced motion is not actually honored (the CSS rule only sets will-change).

Y.note: Clean, well-labeled cards with live curve and reference outputs, a pause toggle, reduced-motion start-paused handling, and good mobile layout, but Plant and Snap are both ease-out shapes and the stickiness is only a long tail.

Z.note: Bare ball-on-track loops with no curve graph, no readings or live values, no pause, and no hold at the ends; reduced motion only shortens the CSS animation to 1ms, and Sticky Snap is close to a plain ease-in-out.
